type.description: Kind of contact. A username ending in 'bot' is telegram_bot.

value.description: The contact exactly as in the text: '@username', 't.me/channel', 'example.ru'. If the text has a mask such as [PHONE], [USER], [TG_LINK] or [EMAIL], copy the mask unchanged and never invent the real value.
value.title: Value

purpose.description: What to contact for, a few words in Russian as in the text ('для заказов', 'по вопросам сбора'); null if not stated.
purpose.title: Purpose

EquipmentCategory.description: Тип техніки. v2: дрони розбито на підтипи, додано мережі, IT, захист, спорядження, медицину, озброєння.
EquipmentCategory.title: EquipmentCategory

name.description: Model or item name as written in the text, without quantity, e.g. 'ТА-57', 'TYT-7500', 'кабель полевой П-274м'.
name.title: Name

category.description: Equipment type. radio: radios, repeaters, MANET modules; phone: field/landline phones; antenna_mast: antennas, masts; cable: cables, field lines, reels; satellite: satellite terminals, Starlink; network: routers, switches, Wi-Fi bridges, mesh nodes; drone_fpv: FPV drones; drone_multirotor: recon quadcopters (Mavic, Matrice, Autel) and heavy multirotors; drone_fixed_wing: fixed-wing UAVs; drone_component: motors, video transmitters, controllers, goggles, drone batteries, frames; ew_sigint: EW/jammers, SIGINT, drone detectors, radars; optics: thermal and night sights, rangefinders, binoculars; power: generators, batteries not for drones, power banks, chargers, solar panels; vehicle: cars, motorcycles, ATVs and parts; it_hardware: laptops, tablets, smartphones, flash drives; software: apps, messengers, firmware, VPN; tools: tools, soldering, repair kits, consumables; protective_gear: body armor, helmets, plate carriers, ballistic glasses; field_gear: clothing, boots, chest rigs, sleeping bags, tents, trench candles; medical: first aid kits, tourniquets, dressings, medical devices, medicines; weapon_related: weapons, ammunition, drone drop munitions, detonators and their accessories; other: anything else.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer or brand if explicitly stated (e.g. 'Silvus', 'Аргус-М'), including a brand that is part of the model name ('TYT-7500' -> 'TYT'), otherwise null. Do not guess; a country is not a manufacturer.
manufacturer.title: Manufacturer

quantity.description: Number of items or amount only if a number is written explicitly ('10 шт.' -> 10, '6 км' -> 6); otherwise null.
quantity.title: Quantity

unit.description: Unit for quantity: 'шт' for pieces, or the unit from the text ('км', 'м', 'кг'). Null if quantity is null.
unit.title: Unit

status.description: What happens to this item in the post. needed: money is being raised or the item is wanted; purchased: bought, ordered, on the way; delivered: handed over to a unit or person; in_use: used, tested, configured; damaged_lost: broken, destroyed, lost, captured; for_sale: offered or advertised; mentioned: anything else.

recipient.description: Unit, group or person the item is for or was handed to, as in organizations or persons ('204 СПН "Ахмат"', 'позывной Кот'); null if not stated.
recipient.title: Recipient

specs.description: Technical characteristics stated for this item (range, frequency, power, capacity, size, weight, setup time). Empty list if none.
specs.title: Specs

amount_min.description: Amount as a plain number: '14300 рублей' -> 14300, '80к' -> 80000, '1м' -> 1000000. For a range, the lower bound.
amount_min.title: Amount Min

amount_max.description: Upper bound for a range ('от 80к до 120к' -> 120000), otherwise null.
amount_max.title: Amount Max

name.description: Name in nominative case, without emoji, obvious typos fixed ('Призрак Новоросии' -> 'Призрак Новороссии'); a company by its short name ('Московский завод осветительных установок Аргус-М' -> 'Аргус-М'). Exclude social platforms mentioned only as links (Telegram, VK, Rutube, Дзен, MAX).
name.title: Name

role.description: Role in this post: recipient of help or equipment, supplier/manufacturer/fundraiser, partner, or just mentioned.

provider.description: Bank, service or crypto network as written, normalized: 'Сбербанк', 'Т-Банк', 'ЮMoney', 'USDT TRC20', 'BTC', 'TON'. Null if not stated.
provider.title: Provider

identifier.description: Card, phone, wallet address or link exactly as in the text, without spaces added or removed in the middle. If the text has a mask such as [CARD], [PHONE], [WALLET] or [PAY_LINK], copy the mask unchanged.
identifier.title: Identifier

holder.description: Name of the recipient or card holder exactly as written ('Тимур Максимович Г.'), null if not stated.
holder.title: Holder

name.description: Name, surname or call sign exactly as written, in nominative case ('Киба', 'Тимур Громов', 'позывной Кот'). Only people named in the text; not public figures mentioned in passing news.
name.title: Name

role.description: Role of the person in the post.

parameter.description: Parameter name in Russian, lower case, as in the text: 'высота', 'дальность', 'частота', 'емкость', 'вес'.
parameter.title: Parameter

value.description: Value with unit and qualifiers as written: 'до 12 м', '433 МГц', '10000 мАч', 'не более 5-10 минут'.
value.title: Value

post_type.description: Main purpose of the post. Pick one. A post that mainly asks for money is fundraising even if it lists equipment.

language.description: Main language of the text. Russian with English technical terms is still 'ru'; use 'mixed' only when whole sentences are in different languages.

summary.description: One-sentence summary in Ukrainian, up to 300 characters.
summary.title: Summary

equipment.description: Concrete equipment, devices or software products mentioned. A specific item the post is about counts even without a model name ('убило новый генератор' -> 'генератор'); general mentions of equipment types ('генераторы в больницах') and generic words like 'связь' or 'оборудование' do not. Empty list if none.
equipment.title: Equipment

technical_content.description: Kinds of technical information present in the post. Empty list if none.
technical_content.title: Technical Content

organizations.description: Organizations named in the text. Empty list if none.
organizations.title: Organizations

persons.description: People and call signs named in the text. Empty list if none.
persons.title: Persons

locations.description: Geographic places (countries, regions, cities, districts) in nominative case and full form, always in Russian: 'в Мск' -> 'Москва', 'Mariupol' -> 'Мариуполь'. Include the place where equipment is made ('производства Украины' -> 'Украина', 'Московский завод' -> 'Москва'). No metro stations. Empty list if none.
locations.title: Locations

contacts.description: Ways to contact the author or others: Telegram users, bots, channels, phones, e-mails, websites. Not payment details. Empty list if none.
contacts.title: Contacts

payment_details.description: Where to send money: cards, SBP phones, accounts, crypto wallets, payment links. Empty list if none.
payment_details.title: Payment Details

money.description: Money amounts mentioned. Empty list if none.
money.title: Money

event_date.description: Date of the event the post is about, YYYY-MM-DD, only if day, month and year can be read from the text (the year may come from an event name such as 'Дронница-2026'). For a range use the start date. Relative dates -> null.
event_date.title: Event Date

call_to_action.description: True if the post asks readers to do something: write to a bot or DM, apply, register, repost, send or donate.
call_to_action.title: Call To Action
